rationale: The bounded product-semantics change spans three canonical owners and lacks deterministic propagation, so it requires a scoped formal delivery path. Compact Delivery is not evidenced because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are absent; Verified Change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Three canonical owners and three source paths are affected.
Four derived paths exist, but deterministic propagation is false.
